sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Answering questions
Ask User keeps explicit choice-versus-custom draft identity per question. Secret answers use a password field and remain only in the volatile draft coordinator until canonical resolution or cancellation.

Unaccepted or cancelled input does not create a user receipt.

## Approving actions
The [Flower approval surface](flower-approval-surface.md) owns the approval list, bounded layout, disclosure, focus, exact batch membership, and presentation contract. It shares the interaction submission guard and canonical reconciliation boundary described above.

## Context and recovery
Runtime restart recovery is quiet unless content cannot be recovered, in which case the affected row offers a nonblocking retry. All shipped locales provide the same distinction; keyboard users can focus the circle and dismiss its details with Escape.

sections.title: Contract

Single/multiple approvals share one flat list. Rows pair safe operation labels with independent Reject/Allow once capsules and actual risk/targets/reasons. After input advances to approval, focus the first enabled decision or Stop.

## Canonical decisions and drafts
Primary requested approvals remain visible when `can_approve=false`, adapters cannot mutate, thread is read-only or detail is pending. Disable every decision with canonical/read-only reason. Local handoff, consumed sets, generations or busy reducers cannot own visibility.

Result content loss and child attention do not themselves create parent confirmation controls. The UI shows canonical tool Activity and actual input/approval requests; only real model-requested observation produces verification activity. Previously saved requests remain visible and answerable.

## Safe presentation
One pure presenter owns trusted operation/title/description/command/target/risk fields. Localized fallbacks are independent strings, never parsed from translated sentences; internal names/encoding prefixes remain hidden.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
Published Floe Markdown parsing owns GFM syntax with CJK-aware emphasis boundaries for completed and streamed text. Display parsing never writes back to canonical messages or provider cache input. New messages preserve complete sources; old records lacking sources remain readable without rewriting historical data.

## Inline-code references
Inline Markdown code derives from the published Floe `--inline-code-foreground` and `--inline-code-background` pair.

Fenced code, copy behavior and canonical content remain independent.

Theme changes preserve focus, selection, DOM and geometry; see [message appearance](flower-message-appearance.md).

## Source-card presentation
Sources start collapsed, showing the count and a deduplicated stack of up to four website icons plus an overflow count. Sources never expose their own copy button. Inline citations retain their existing links.

## Website icons
The shared Flower UI bundles 27 common website marks from pinned theSVG assets with audited per-icon licenses. Icon enhancement runs independently after Markdown rendering; collapse/expand never restarts it.

The renderer receives image bytes, never a third-party tracking URL.

## Authored bibliography
Assistant Markdown can already contain an explicit bibliography inside an unlabelled, `text` or `plaintext` fence. This is display-only authored content: it neither fabricates canonical source annotations nor binds numeric prose references to provider metadata. User messages and fetched external Markdown do not enable this assistant-specific presentation.

Settings recovery stays inside the collapsed row, with a reachable Retry and unchanged height. It replaces compact summary copy until recovery; active Stop remains available. The published shell cannot clip recovery outside its bounds. Expanded recovery uses the existing floating notice stack.

## Retained editor and explicit entry
The same ordinary editor moves between compact/detail presentations. Specialized decisions retain separate controls; input/approval/work priority follows [presence](flower-companion-presence.md), never converts a decision/status entry into an editor.

## Editor layout and growth
Toolbar left stays empty; permission/model/reasoning remain in More during loading/errors. Recovery/guidance sit above the editor. Short input leaves no blank space beneath the toolbar; multiline growth moves it without replacing the editor. Dedicated pages retain complete starter suggestions.

## Motion and surface treatment
One shell grows upward/outward in width and height, preserving bottom edge, border, background and clipping. Close dissolves detail before compact layout; reversal follows current phase. Exit keeps fixed coordinates and Activity height, without origin flashes. Published forced-color and focus indicators remain.

concepts.title: Flower companion presence
concepts.summary: Collapsed Flower projects canonical summaries and current-run detail through the existing workspace stream. Work, pending decisions and drafts have explicit precedence; historical completion is never new feedback. Presence neither expands Flower nor acknowledges reads. sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Status and live output
Canonical priority is running, queued, attention, unread failure, unread cancellation, unread completion, unavailable, idle. Reduced motion disables flow/tracking/arrival effects while retaining semantic text/color. Live tails use matching current-run facts without exposing raw thinking.

## Completion acknowledgement
Only a matching successful run previously observed running while collapsed may temporarily replace an idle editor with localized completion feedback. Exclude history, queued-only work, failures, cancellation, attention, expired/mismatched runs and completion while other running/queued work remains. Feedback is ephemeral, not canonical presence.

## Observation and transport
Use the shared workspace SSE; summaries cannot invent personal read state. Expansion requests current selected detail without a second stream; disconnect uses existing recovery.

## Composer precedence
One derived entry owns rendering/target, in this order:
1. Current-thread pending decision, regardless of question type or draft.
2. Ordinary editor for draft, attachment, reference, focus or IME; inspection if editing unavailable.
3. Eligible running, queued, unread-failure or ephemeral-completion target button.
4. Ordinary editor or read-only/unavailable inspection.

[Activity companion](flower-activity-companion.md) owns question activation and one-shot focus handoffs.

concepts.title: Flower composer attachments
concepts.summary: Flower owns connection-local attachment editing; host adapters authenticate staging, Redeven owns staged bytes/unadmitted commands and Floret owns admitted history. Select, paste, drop, retry, remove, preview and attachment-only send share one controller. Text above 50,000 Unicode code points converts only after successful staging, preserving IME and source text on failure.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
Selection during capability loading retains queued local bytes. Invalid Unicode, drift, quota, upload/restore or pre-capture failure preserves the editor. Once captured, the transport outbox owns submission and explicit recovery; later failures never overwrite newer composer edits. Attachment-only sends never synthesize prompts; restoration never sends automatically.

All file types remain selectable and sendable regardless of model modalities or tool support. Upload limits and transport readiness remain authoritative; presentation routes never mark staged files incompatible. Model changes, revision changes and capability refreshes preserve staged readiness without uploading again. The model menu does not pre-judge attachment support or poll each model for attachment compatibility. Desktop IPC and Env App preview loaders accept canonical opaque bytes; preview availability does not decide whether a file can be sent. Models receive native content when supported or an honest attachment manifest and choose how to process it.

## Connection-local editing
Env App uses one Shell-owned coordinator across Activity/Workbench; Desktop uses one per connection, never a module singleton. Admission uncertainty retains request identity for reconciliation/retry.

## Queued content
Execution leaves select/paste/drop/reference controls usable. Users may add/remove/send resources; staged copies survive queue removal and canonical bytes remain immutable.

## Canonical Presentation
Previews use authenticated `loadMessageAttachment`: Env App prepares local credentials; Desktop uses scoped Runtime IPC GET with bounded canonical-MIME bytes. Chromium coverage includes 320 CSS pixels without horizontal overflow.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Ask Flower context
Launcher and Tessiven composers show linked chips inside their composite input. Chips wrap/scroll within a bounded region under local-scroll rules; editable `@` references retain controls.

## Composer interaction
An editable `@` token requires whitespace boundary and collapsed caret. Focus changes a restrained border color, preserving one-pixel geometry/shadow and explicit candidate/action focus indicators.

## New conversation origin page
[Page context](flower-page-context.md) owns opening/New capture, authorized readers, scope and removal. Env App reuses Ask Flower's preview/text viewer for draft and submitted snapshots without transferring draft authority.

## Conversation references
[Thread references](flower-thread-references.md) own frozen snapshots, menus, preview, removal and recovery under the shared draft owner.

## Bounded discovery
Search uses immutable thread working directory or the new-thread directory draft. Slashless tokens use bounded global matching. Root read failures are retryable; inaccessible descendants are skipped within the same bounded scan.

## Draft and admission
Ordered file/directory/page/thread chips have local identities/host labels and stay in connection memory, never persistence or another connection. [Tool runtime](../ai/ai-tool-runtime.md) defines one-pass canonical `MessageReference`/context admission.

## Queue previews and editing
Compact queue references preview by exact ThreadID/QueueID/ReferenceID. Resubmission repeats authorization/admission; labels cannot reconstruct resource authority.

sections.title: Boundaries

Once admitted, Redeven does not retain a second queryable message-reference record, and canonical reference presentation and navigation derive from Floret reads plus current host authorization.

concepts.title: Flower personal conversation preferences
concepts.summary: Explicit model, directory and model-owned reasoning choices are remembered per authenticated namespace, endpoint and user. Loading/switching threads never writes defaults. New roots prefer explicit launch/draft choices, then personal memory, then configuration; existing threads and immutable turns retain confirmed settings.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Ownership and persistence
`ai_conversation_preferences` belongs to product schema v11. Transactional v10→v11 validates source/target shapes, preserves data and never infers preferences from old threads. Missing stable scope cannot read another user's defaults.

## Selection events
Patch only the chosen field. Existing-thread edits must succeed before saving memory; memory failure cannot roll back confirmed thread state. Explicit Default differs from absent memory; Default/budget and Off/budget semantics remain.

## Drafts and admission
Draft overrides remain distinct from effective model/directory admission values; old selection cannot seed a new draft. Without explicit/remembered reasoning, root launch freezes explicit Default so retries cannot acquire later memory. Server [canonicalization](../ai/model-reasoning-runtime.md) owns model capability. Existing busy/queued/unresolved-input edit restrictions apply.

## Concurrency and failure
Adapters serialize captured patches and load latest revision; the store atomically merges with compare-and-set. Stale writes return 409 without auto-retry. Captured target/model identity fences late responses against navigation or retargeting.

The originating surface consumes its authoritative response/settings revision without reloading shared model resources; other surfaces refresh persisted preferences. Catalog refresh is reserved for configuration changes, preventing model/reasoning selection from replacing the composer with loading UI.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body: This is Redeven product preference policy using already published Floret capabilities, not a generic upstream settings framework. Runtime catalogs, filesystem scope, canonical Thread settings, and immutable Turn execution remain authoritative. Model and directory recovery use existing controls and host notifications, not new switches, save buttons, or confirmation dialogs.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Navigation and presentation
One header owns the title and return action; a separate primary tab bar uses distinct Skills/MCP/Plugins icons and a persistent selected underline. Arrow/Home/End navigation and focus remain accessible. Each panel begins with one compact filter/action toolbar instead of repeating its tab title. Preserve check timestamps in entry details.

## Entry icons
Decorative 32px row icons retain names and row height; never inject untrusted SVG or create icon-only targets. [MCP runtime](../ai/mcp-runtime.md#presentation-icons) owns discovery/persistence.

## Skills
Usable connections load catalog/source metadata. Serialized reads/mutations prevent stale refresh overwrite. Read-only browsing never installs bundled files.

## MCP
Edit remote HTTP endpoints or local executables with one argument per line. Never prefill secrets: omitted values preserve, explicit empty object clears. Search, enabled filter, discovered tools, explicit checks and confirmed removal remain available.

The default MCP form contains connection type and endpoint, or executable and arguments. Name and server ID are optional fields inside Advanced, with an Automatic placeholder. Existing IDs remain read-only and selectable. The runtime owns naming and ID allocation; submitting an unnamed connection needs no client-side slug. The primary creation action is Add server, while edits use Save. Omit introductory prose for remote connections; enabled local connections disclose command execution in one sentence at the save decision. Failed submissions retain all draft fields and reopening a dialog resets the disclosure.

## Agent Plugins
The Plugins destination presents installed management directly when no catalog source is configured; omit the Installed/Discover control, official-directory placeholders and discovery requests. With sources, show the high-contrast Installed/Discover control and a responsive card gallery. Keep independent installed/discovery search values and the selected source across view changes. Opening Discover loads the selected source automatically; switching sources or leaving discovery invalidates older responses. Primary tabs and local view controls have distinct visual treatments. Omit introductory prose, raw environment identifiers and repeated headings from the landing surface. Empty libraries show a short factual title and direct actions; installed search appears only when there are entries to search; discovery search remains available while a configured catalog loads. Filter misses show Clear filters instead of installation guidance. Selecting a card opens one focused detail dialog: description, enable control and components first; install hashes and connection configuration remain in disclosures. Avoid repeating management controls in the gallery. The plugin empty state supplies one install action; no marketing headline, explanatory paragraph or dashed placeholder frame competes with it. Skills and MCP use the same concise empty-state pattern. Preserve execution and destructive-action explanations at their relevant decision point. Both light/dark themes and narrow screens preserve readable controls without horizontal overflow.

Preparation, preview and commit are distinct. Closing a pending preview never reopens it when an older poll completes; its operation remains resumable. Failed requests retain input. Component selection and enablement are explicit; package preparation never executes commands. Credential editing uses named password fields, replacement and explicit clearing, never returned secret values. Uninstall confirms separately and retains data by default.

Package-owned Skills/MCP entries navigate to their owning plugin instead of offering standalone mutation. Reopening the same owner works repeatedly. Plugin mutations invalidate mounted Skill/MCP catalogs without resetting filters or tabs. Async responses do not override dismissed dialogs. Reader/admin and process-execution capabilities remain independent.

Manage sources is a focused dialog outside browsing; retain failed input, restrict mutations to administrators, and mark runtime-managed sources without offering removal. Removing the last source returns to installed management. Catalog failure shows Retry, not an empty catalog; successful empty catalogs and search misses remain distinct. Names, descriptions and authors are inert presentation metadata, not approval claims. Catalog cards enter the existing source preparation and review flow; the actual package manifest owns the preview. No official catalog is supplied. [Catalog integration](../ai/flower-plugin-catalogs.md) owns activation and schema rules. [The runtime contract](../ai/flower-agent-plugins.md) defines format, storage, updates and permission boundaries.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Baseline and ownership
ThreadFactsSource carries body-free workspace/account/Computer facts. Root/child windows are independent; one worker coalesces <=64 dirty parents without blocking facts. [Adapter](../ai/floret-redeven-adapter-and-projection.md) owns authorization. Register before freezing navigation-ordered roots; emit Ready, <=25-summary pages, baseline_complete, then private states. Facts wait; accepted reads bypass sidebar preparation. Cancellation drains budgets/queues without Next. Broken observation invalidates observation, never skips pinned roots.

Merge pages immediately; prune only on completion, preserving creation/selection. [Startup](../architecture/flower-startup-presentation.md) admits first page, confirmed empty inventory or selected detail, never partial Ready. HTTP refresh: 25-row cancellable pages, 10 s per progressing page, retained partial success. Desktop cancels history/item POSTs. Baseline precedes shared loading; coalesce demand except command confirmation. Navigation/disposal/transport cancels waiters; reconnect retains content/draft/scroll.

## Reading windows
Root/child revisions fence replacement; baseline/delta share one subscription. Initial: 50 items, 1 KiB previews, Activity summaries and existing byte bound. Paging: 150 items/512 KiB; POST: 64 KiB JSON/150 IDs; locator: 8 KiB; exact membership: 448 KiB previews excluding hydrated bodies. Viewer read events and current-only updates cannot manufacture loaded-content coverage.

Charge max(transmitted, window_bytes). Receipts refresh accepted intervals without forcing Latest. Retain confirmed sealed bodies and mounted visible/focused/selected live islands; evict inactive documents whole. Prefetch near missing intervals. One explicit input demand owns handoff, including stationary/folded edges; layout/HTTP cannot traverse. Anchors guide placement, never admission. Failures retain draft/content with Retry.

Collapsed turns/sequences install public range navigation plus retained rows in one observer. Canonical membership resolves same-turn/run skips; no host hidden-page scan. Only intermediate prose may skip, with active/unknown/trailing/approval/input/unsafe facts as boundaries. Accepted finite IDs prevent repeated skips on refresh; gaps stay reachable by scrolling/expansion. [Sequence proofs](flower-tool-sequences.md#membership-and-counts) prevent duplicate folded summaries. HTTP/observer share proof; metadata reads acquire neither bodies nor extra observers. Keyed gaps update affected rows only. Disclosure cancels navigation, restores interest and retires demand; new input starts another.

Foreground pages may publish while baselines queue. Reuse prefixes only with exact sealedID/kind/turn/run/ordinal/canonicalOrdinal; stale windows prove no ends. Preserve focused/selected/disclosed DOM. Receipt alignment uses <=one preview page/displayed span; other gaps remain demand. Sequence contract owns counts/unknown labels. Patch summaries show actual mutation/type or localized count, retaining totals/files on expansion. Activity summaries hold bounded shapes/scalars; field reads use frozen authorized sources.

## Bodies and transport
Retain accepted prose/media/anchors/follow during refresh; skeletons cover only unread content. One observer admits within 160 px. Text/disclosure share two slots/15 s, prioritizing live/interactive, visible, then background with aging every eight admissions. Offscreen/navigation cancels; errors expose Retry.

ThreadCache binds item/turn/run/source. Public text reads <=16 KiB at accepted UTF-8 offsets; coalesce growth and yield between chunks. Live visibility owners survive complete extents; completed reads detach parent cancellation listeners without aborting. Navigation, offscreen visibility and source changes retain cancellation. No polling/full-prefix download. Source/sealing change restarts from canonical preview while retaining readable content until replacement. Same-source progress survives refresh; reject late replies. Retired locator source_changed needs authoritative ItemBody: release slot and await observation, never guess offsets. Terminal/exhausted reads Retry without replay.

live:false alone does not change source. Same-source previews atomically update text/pending/locator; overlap retains layout and suffix resumes at current offset. Changed source retires reads; identity/range/prefix/empty-nonterminal failures stay explicit.

Schema v3 has one decoder. Base64 fragments <=32 KiB carry ID/index/count/total and exact scope/revision with contiguous version/UTF-8 offsets. Growth carries locators. Constant-storage coalescing preserves original base/semantics. Bound 16 pending batches, 32 MiB envelope/subscriber and 32 MiB global refs. Started frames are immutable; byte-accounted coverage suppresses duplicates. Summary/private/child mailboxes stay separate. Pending controls use authorized 64-item pages back to user boundary, verify leaf/version and individually read oversized items, never full View/body. Missing authority or a broken sequence invalidates observation.

## DOM and retention
Offscreen sections retain DOM/height; visible/live/focused/selected content stays accessible. Partition active turns near 24 rows after prose, preserving groups/owners. Keyed subscriptions dispose with owners. Thread identity publishes only on replacement; fields stay reactive. Equal replacements/empty previews retain membership; previews reproject matching tools. Unchanged tokens/entries/coverage reuse summaries. Structural facts avoid per-field observers. Titles never rescan history; thinking retains its block; presence tracks empty/nonempty; empty coverage ignores leaf changes; following scans no old anchors.

[Activity](flower-activity-interaction.md) owns inspection/before-paint scroll; Fork inherits no disclosure. Readiness/body growth cannot change restoration provenance or cancel unrelated motion; full baseline/hydration admits history. Stage cold sealed Markdown across reconnect and reveal complete final geometry without entrance motion. Navigation suppresses arrivals until placed. Count cache objects once without reactive recursion. Current run/visible anchors guide compaction; paging restores decoration.

Inactive cache: 12 threads/32 MiB estimated, protecting selected/retained/in-flight owners and summaries. Append logs: 256 chunks/256 KiB with absolute cursors/exact-source catchup; active documents/selection uncapped. Catchup notice waits 200 ms, never delays publication. [Composer](flower-turn-launcher.md) owns captured-input DOM before confirmation.

## Recovery
Detail/baseline backoff: 200/600/1200 ms, <=4 attempts/15 s. New revisions retire unpublished state; leaf drift recovers, foreign/malformed stops. Navigation/disposal/connection cancels. Exhaustion retains draft/DOM/scroll with interrupted-sync Retry, never command replay. history_invalidated permits one bounded read per selection/manual intent, then Retry. Release immediately cancels interest; child release affects only its slot; one-shot windows inherit none.

Transport/handshake/gaps retain backoff; disposal cannot publish; reconnect publishes a boundary. Observers follow DOM lifetime. Auth/capacity/version/malformed stop; transport errors may classify, mapper exceptions never retry. Diagnostics retain category/status/epoch and SSE503/baseline504/invalid400/capacity429. Unknown effects keep request keys.

A pointer-local floating stack above the companion shows sync status, Resync and minimizable details without moving content or occupying headers. Escape/outside dismisses without stealing focus; targets >=44 px. The owner coalesces reconnect. Restored requires current connection/selected authoritative detail, not optional collapsed reads. Dismiss after 2.6 s unless focused/hovered/expanded. Preserve drafts/selection/bounds. Canonical cancellation owns Stopping; viewer facts grant no coverage. [Approvals](flower-approval-context.md), [read state](flower-read-state.md) and [turn disclosure](flower-turn-process-disclosure.md) retain policy.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Transcript reading scale
Assistant/user text uses `0.875rem` and unitless `1.75` line height. Composer controls retain published control scale.

## Assistant reading roles
Body/headings retain the chat foreground. Presentation does not rewrite Markdown or infer metadata from authored bold text, dates, identifiers or citations. [Citations](flower-citations.md) own destinations/copy.

## Filled messages and content
Sent text/answered-question receipts mix 4% theme foreground into the published `floe-well-on-plane` fill for clearer separation from the content canvas, with `floe-radius-group` corners and 16px horizontal padding. Reading ink derives from the theme foreground with stronger light/dark luminance; ordinary text, full questions and answers share that ink and the transcript reading scale. Across published presets and both materials, body ink clears 7:1 and is no weaker than assistant ink on the same capsule surface. Only status/redacted metadata is secondary. Queued input retains its separate paint and spacing.

Answered receipts retain every complete question followed by its answer in canonical order, without disclosure or choices. Questions use regular weight, answers medium weight, and a quiet check accompanies the localized status. Spacing and thin neutral separators distinguish multiple responses. Short receipts fit their content without a minimum-width panel.

Text, placeholders and actions share the right edge; the full-row history wrapper makes the 78% desktop bubble limit relative to the transcript. Short text fits intrinsically; narrow views retain the full-column limit. Error/code insets use readable foreground and selection roles over their own backgrounds.

## User media and resources
Order is image thumbnails, wrapping resource cards, text bubble, then timestamp/copy. Resource/image-only messages omit empty bubbles. Canonical previews use exact thread/turn/reference identity; queued actions retain their separate authority/click guard.

## Native text selection
Filled text, including transparent table headers, reverses capsule ink and fill for visible native selection; code and queued insets retain their own selection roles. Selection never changes parsing, copying or transport. Browser checks require 4.5:1 supporting/selected text and a visible selection surface across all presets/materials. Copying answered receipts retains complete ordered questions/answers and the localized hidden-answer placeholder. [Highlighting](flower-code-highlighting.md) retains its own stable-content contract.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Mechanism
The composer always keeps its model label visible without an availability spinner or busy status.

Runtime status distinguishes no Desktop provider (`not_configured`), configured but unavailable keys or catalog (`missing_keys` or `empty`), and actual connection or protocol errors.

## Model identity and recovery
Thread snapshots, list items, and patches carry `model_id` and `reasoning_selection` as thread defaults. The last is a disabled, ungrouped display of a thread's missing model; Flower never silently replaces it.

See [reasoning selection ownership](flower-reasoning-selection.md) for loading, draft, and submission rules.

## Web search presentation
Model choices display the shared search badge from the server's readonly `web_search` projection. A provider brand or frontend model name never enables search. See [model directory ownership](../ai/model-directory-and-selection.md).

## Permission and navigation
Below the 768px viewport breakpoint, the composer keeps permission status and selection in its own More panel, alongside any other overflow controls.

Saving disables only the permission control, prevents duplicate requests, merges the authoritative settings response, and restores the confirmed value on failure.

Warm sessions switch without provider or transcript remount and stale loads cannot replace the current thread.

sections.body:

After creation, its `model_id`, `reasoning_selection`, and `permission_type` are authoritative; Thread changes write to its settings, while new-thread overrides stay connection-local and never update environment defaults.

The header switcher is only a product-specific compact presentation; it does not create a second selected-thread owner or change the requested, committed, and content-presented ordering.

sections.body:
## Model request
Each logical request and attempt has its own start, first-output time, last semantic-progress time and estimated received output tokens. Local tools, approvals and user input never use this model-pause presentation.

Only phase text is a live region; numerical updates are readable without repeated automatic announcements.

## Indicator geometry
A live run indicator holds one width while it reports. Inside a host that gives it a bounded track, the mark and phase label keep a constant start inset, the token-and-clock metric keeps a constant end inset, and digits grow only in the free space between them. Reveal dots reserve their full width instead of animating it, so no tick resizes or recenters the indicator. The [subagent detail window](flower-subagent-detail-window.md) supplies that track in its footer rail.

## Progress symbol
The shared Flower mark retains its five-petal geometry.

The symbol is decorative beside the existing localized status text and does not create another live announcement or execution state.

## Edit arguments
The frozen tool definition supplies one optional argument preview parser per call. Their input budget is 1 MiB per call, with bounded JSON depth and field counts.

[Confirmed file Activity](flower-file-activity.md) remains the durable outcome.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
The parent transcript merges messages, anchored decorations and events by published canonical_ordinal on the queried Path; received time is display-only. Published Floret v7.61.0 supplies optional parent_turn_id from canonical receipt order.

Event headers keep the received time directly after the source/status in one compact row. Long source names truncate within the available width, including narrow companion surfaces. The source-name button is the only child-navigation action; report expansion stays independent. Preserve the default header row height for disclosure anchoring. Layout uses CSS without measurement listeners, polling or extra reads.

Explicit group expansion completes only its finite canonical receipt interval. Source notifications coalesce into the existing reader. unacknowledged through the presentation checks themselves.

and the existing retry policy. Repeated presentation of the same confirmed

concepts.title: Flower streaming stability
concepts.summary: Indexed ThreadCache and published incremental Markdown apply actor-native changes only to affected text/DOM. Preserve history, code color, copy, focus, selection and disclosure. Semantic changes stay visible; malformed updates recover through the single live-state owner without suppressing output or adding lifecycle.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Incremental owners
Indexed item/message records initialize from snapshots. Text/extent growth preserves window/turn/decoration identity; only structural changes recompute relevant metadata. Argument previews update one block, never completed tools. Validate counters and retire stale/withdrawn attempts. Real removal restores adjacent-action/composer focus unless navigation moved it. Tests require zero historical ordinal reads for 20 appends across 100/10,000 archived items.

Published createIncrementalMarkdownParser owns Marked/CJK/GFM. reset installs full baseline, append changes regions and finish corrects complete content. Changed snapshots reset because token offsets/identity can move; reuse only exact tokens/offsets. Same-source metadata preserves regions. Completion/collapse/replacement retains every authored block. [Highlighting](flower-code-highlighting.md)/[media](flower-inline-media.md) retain their owners.

## Text and layout
New prose fades to currentColor over 320 ms via 20 fixed CSS highlight phases, without node splitting, line movement or delivery delay. History/corrections are immediate; links/code/media keep colors. No stylesheet changes, computed-style reads or per-frame inline writes. Limit 32 transient groups/owner and diff inspection to 8,192 characters/128 nodes per region; larger changes appear immediately. Completion settles valid effects; reset/disposal/hidden/reduced-motion/forced-color clears them. Published hot drag/resize also settles ink immediately while text, selection and DOM remain live; only post-release additions animate. Historical/unsupported-API owners schedule nothing.

Cold historical bodies stage until complete, retaining offset/staging through reconnect; expose final Markdown geometry without height motion. Sample table/code/list/text from first visible frame. Existing prose/live output remain incremental. Font measurements use disposable completion/error listeners, not detached FontFaceSet.ready retention. Companion reads newest relevant record plus bounded Unicode tail.

## Queue and measurements
One ordered frame queue atomically applies envelopes in reactive batches. Cooperative 4 ms budget includes reactive work and yields between envelopes, never preempts one expensive envelope. Capture failures inside batch so recovery commits before rethrow to connection owner. Ready waits for drain; other reads pause at 16 frames/1 MiB. Epoch/failure/disposal releases readers and fences late callbacks.

Coalesce only contiguous one-item appends with exact thread/item/turn/run/reading revision and same attempt facts except time/monotonic progress. Keep semantic boundaries/clears; join once preserving UTF-8/version. Gaps reject whole pending batch and report one sync error. Growth bounds: 64 frames/4 MiB/250 ms, 75 ms during drag/resize. Semantic timer may replace stalled rAF but never overtake growth. One valid 32 MiB wire envelope plus reserve is allowed with backpressure. Diagnostics omit content. Copy success feedback lasts 1.6 s; denial is never success.

Explicit real-Service qualifier freezes history/provider cadence and measures production Runtime/Electron CPU, allocation, wire, frame/input/click/output. After timing, real disclosure controls compare all prose/thinking against canonical content. [Long-thread](../operations/flower-long-thread-gate.md) adds sustained growth/floating input; both stay outside unified gates. Synthetic task CPU/heap/allocation/decoded queue samples mutate state only after timing and cannot certify providers/encryption or peak memory.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Terminal facts
Floret owns the nested `ActivityItem.presentation` contract and merges results with their stable call presentation. Labels and descriptions are authoritative; the typed operation supplies localized fallback text.

The five-line independently scrolling output viewport retains its existing owner.

An omitted output field is pending content, never an empty canonical frame with a nonzero first sequence. Wait for small-field hydration before polling or installing its sequence; large fields use source-bound ranges, then acknowledge their watermark before adding process deltas. Existing output and selection survive handoff.

Published Floret v7.95.0 atomic activity reads own the bytes, sequence range, process identity and deferred source together. Flower never stamps a newer summary's range onto previously accepted bytes. Canonical activity status remains current independently. Check execution identity and range before publishing optional details; retain accepted output on failure. One in-flight read coalesces revisions; failure latches until explicit Retry, visibility reentry or connection change. Collapsed/offscreen rows do not read. No additional backend scan, transcript snapshot or transport contract is introduced.

Malformed process output stops its local poll and exposes a localized read-only Retry without raw diagnostics; other messages and stream observation continue. Canonical stream validation still fails at its existing connection boundary. Write acknowledgements never apply hidden output frames. Equal-watermark snapshots may fill an empty frame or extend its earlier coverage, but duplicate/older snapshots cannot replace a newer live suffix.

Inactive output caches have 200-entry / 8 MiB estimated-byte limits. Mounted outputs remain retained until release; frame metadata coalesces after 128 records without changing sequence checks. These cache limits do not truncate an active process output or its canonical history.

## Interaction boundary
[Activity disclosure interaction](flower-activity-interaction.md) owns stable triggers, manual choices, animation, transcript following, and floating controls across all renderers. Approval state is never a row badge, chip, metadata line, title suffix, tooltip, detail, or ordinary activity ARIA label. Completing a decision removes that dock without inserting an approval outcome into history.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Selection and navigation
Rail feedback precedes commit by two animation callbacks and a task; hidden documents skip frames. Latest intent supersedes prior work; summaries cannot bypass coordination. Reveal after required baseline/handoff, measurable layout and visible historical text settle. Cached windows renew bounded interest if needed; ready caches prepare immediately. Never await runtime quiet. Canceled reads cannot release newer selections.

One loader owns selection/reselect/reconnect/retry. Position transcript and active sequence after placement before reveal. Restored titles/groups/turns are static; folded turns cannot block readiness, and manual folds retain labels. No smooth initial positioning or timer fallback. One cancellable 200 ms feedback deadline spans detail/body/layout without delaying ready/error state. New chat/navigation/disposal cancels old feedback; frame/composer stay stable and body failures retry locally.

Cached destinations flush effects and use checkVisibility({contentVisibilityAuto:true}). ResizeObserver corrects above-viewport growth before paint; rAF/visibility handles reveal/body work. No polls/per-row observers. Explicit wheel/touch/scrollbar/keyboard pauses following through late reads; scroll events alone do not. Two slots prioritize visible/margin text and cancel obsolete demand; ThreadCache retains immutable bodies. Growth/refresh/completion preserves accepted prose/selection. [Live delivery](flower-live-timeline.md) owns validation/retry. Open Latest; reading restoration is separate. Sort by creation descending then ThreadID ascending.

## Continuous history and concurrent activity
Scrolling reads canonical windows automatically, retaining visible/selected/focused rows, details and anchors across live changes. A collapsed short tail retains trailing room during prepend; reclaim it only outside view or as content fills it. Resize preserves anchors; destination preparation clears temporary geometry. Attach content observation after mount and correct growth before paint, without new reads/state/disclosure changes.

Latest remains above the composer away from current tail, even at a historical window bottom; hide during preparation and preserve gesture protection. If tail is installed, smooth-scroll and retire trailing room at arrival. Otherwise cancel obsolete demand, install one bounded tail interest and reveal its prepared destination without walking pages. Root/child share this path.

Observer/reading revision own accepted baselines. Ordered delivery/deduplication cannot discard distinct baselines at equal canonical version; full-view watermarks cannot suppress reading baselines. Retire obsolete refresh markers without invalidating newer interest. Queue budgets remain unchanged.

Collapsed ranges use canonical skip-and-retain to reach prior dialogue. Explicit disclosure shows cached rows immediately and completes only its sequence: one request/document, 40 records/page, finite forward horizon. No full-content button/replacement observer. Show one geometry-neutral indicator after 150 ms; cancellation hides it immediately and only failure exposes Retry. Disclosure changes cancel obsolete navigation; thread/child/Latest clears gap demand. Headers follow canonical order and transfer focus to earlier owners.

Tools/reports retain previews; disclosure reads authorized bodies through the existing owner. Collapse/navigation/disposal cancels unused demand; reconnect restores consumers. Empty activity sources use Floret defaults in source order. Ordinary history retains full expansion; demand pages use published Floret v7.91.0 source-backed summaries without enumerating all turn tools. Runtime document owns mutable live records/versions. No universal latency or expanded-output memory guarantee.

## Detail read ownership
Floret supplies canonical summaries/windows/body reads. ThreadCache owns selection/detail with twelve entries; one bounded coordinator shares navigation, command confirmation and reference preflight. Cancellation never reconnects the workspace stream.

sections.body:
## Resizing
One 220–380 CSS-pixel preference owns desktop sidebar width. Inline resizing updates only its grid track, at most once per frame; drawer width applies only in overlay mode. Mobile, companion and embedded layouts keep their sizing.

One primary-pointer gesture retains the latest sample and settles on release, cancellation, lost capture, blur, layout change or unmount. Release listeners, frames and cursor/selection shielding; persist once per gesture or immediately for keyboard changes. Storage failure cannot interrupt interaction. Width changes cannot reparse Markdown or invalidate the full transcript.

## Rename from the conversation header
The header pencil edits the existing ThreadID, including during execution/loading, with canonical title prefilled and selected. Header/sidebar share one save owner and thread cache.

## Selection and detail reads
[Selection](flower-thread-selection.md) owns deferred commitment, bounded reads, cancellation and recovery. ThreadCache owns committed selection/detail; sidebar intent reserves feedback only.

## Reference action

## Context menu response

The shared resize observer supplies the measured client border box to `SurfaceFloatingLayer`; Floe owns clamping and projected coordinates. Live action changes remeasure without replacing the menu or losing focus. Long paths remain truncated with the full path available on hover.

## Pending replies and approvals

The stable `.flower-thread-rows` owner contains inline size for real/skeleton rows; movable cards cannot be size containers. Keyboard order matches visible search/pin-overlay order. sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Membership and counts
Group >=2 same-thread/turn/run nodes including a tool; thinking qualifies. Preserve call/error/preview/output order and canonical row identity. New singleton may settle prior work without overriding inspection. Thinking moves in place; first canonical node owns DOM while the loaded anchor retains disclosure through paging/navigation.

Prose/users/interactions/compaction/approvals/non-tool errors/Goal updates break groups; Goal/Web Search calls remain tools. Canonically scoped SubAgent calls/report/completion and running attention/waits join, unknown parent ownership/other waits break. Exact uncertain tool errors remain grouped with complete-coverage unconfirmed counts; invalid success-with-uncertainty or uncertain parent lifecycle breaks. Empty assistant placeholders are transparent, unknown text cannot prove continuity. Answered input splits settled work, including newest groups.

Counts require exact boundaries/item/event coverage, possible even in partial windows. Otherwise show only localized Consecutive tool calls and its accessible name, without partial totals/latest tool/loading. Preserve known failure details. Statistics never acquire history/bodies. Paging fills coverage without losing disclosure/focus/selection.

Sparse islands group only with accepted endpoint continuity proofs. Reuse Floret facts or <=8 indexed reads per explicit baseline, sharing maximal results; ordinary streaming does no queries. Hidden prose/compaction/interaction/unknown receipts/active or unsafe facts/scope changes break proof. Metadata is ephemeral; retain only surviving endpoints. Explicit expansion fills <=40 missing items/page without tail resampling or retransmitting retained islands.

## Disclosure and bodies
Settle historical group/turn defaults without motion before exposure; retain explicit choices and animation eligibility. Only admitted live arrivals fold before prose. Wait for row placement; folded turns skip inner positioning. Choices key Runtime/thread/tool and survive updates/reconnect/navigation until refresh. Focus/selection/gestures/open details/away-from-tail reading protect expansion but cannot reopen closed groups. Only explicit disclosure/navigation reopens. Observers are per-group.

Live fold: 260 ms to summary height (2rem desktop/2.75rem coarse), never zero. Summary fades in for last 100 ms after 140 ms delay. Incoming prose stays mounted/inert/invisible until settled, then 160 ms opacity-only reveal. Delivery continues. Existing prose, inspected/history/navigation/reduced-motion work never waits.

Finish title arrivals first. Terminal outer turn owns motion and intact nested geometry; interrupted inner fold transfers opacity/transform. One pending-content map tracks owner/later prose. Reversal waits for new motion; disposal/reduced motion releases content. Measure row once; no per-tool timer/observer/per-frame reactive state.

Closed groups mount shells/summary; first opening mounts bodies, later folds keep them inert. Closed new members wait; whole-turn folding retains inspected bodies. Borrow/restore existing DOM owners at first-node viewport; preserve nested focus/selection/state. Change projections only for membership/status/disclosure/order. Sealed thinking reads only when explicitly open and visible through clips; observe its movable displayed node. Shared two-slot queue prioritizes interaction, cancels obsolete demand and reuses text. Unopened tools read/mount no bodies.

## Progressive completion
Only explicit group opening or enclosing-turn opening that reveals an open group completes missing boundaries; automatic live groups never traverse history. Keep rows usable; transfer inner/outer anchors, focus and detail owners before paint when first node changes. Explicit reopen retains latest-tools destination.

Accept immutable pages without overwriting newer facts/bodies; mutable new IDs join existing bounded tail observation. Fence responses by thread/connection/navigation/document. Collapse stops demand but abort-ignoring transports keep physical slot until settlement. Sample finite tail once; never chase output. Empty exhausted boundaries finish; nonadvancing pages fail without loop. After 15 s show Retry without releasing unsettled slot. Parent receipts reuse interval event reads; no hidden terminal/thinking/report body acquisition.

## Geometry and input
Tool/thinking titles, summaries and times use 13px/18px across states. Prose/icons/summary/progress share left edge; permanent outer/native gutters prevent shifts and blank title rows, including child views. Full-row targets place time/chevron after intrinsic text; only long text shrinks. CSS owns geometry, no text-measure loop.

One native left gutter button/bracket collapses: 24px target, 44px coarse, outside tools. Folded button covers summary with trailing chevron; stable crossfade bounds prioritize counts. Rail stays outside scrolling body and ends before prose; no row connectors/hit-testing loop. Rows 2rem/2.75rem; sequence <=8 rows and 65% transcript, thinking <=20rem/45% window/transcript. Short content retains natural height; thin scrollbars and localized keyboard controls stay accessible.

Native scroll chaining serves thinking/sequences/read-only terminals/files/diffs/code: consume local range, propagate edges. Upward wheel/touch/key intent pauses following, actual bottom return resumes. Canceled/contained/zoom input stays local; interactive editors own input. Shared input-aware controller distinguishes user actions from geometry/programmatic events. Mounted children retain nested anchors. Explicit open positions latest tools before paint; navigation waits for row and destination placement. Restored detail is static; manual folds stay closed. Complete counts may name latest tool without reading body. Collapse focuses trigger; thinking retains offset/completion. [Activity motion](flower-activity-interaction.md#visual-motion) owns arrival coordination.

Expose viewport IDs/localized counts; closed members leave no gaps/ineligible headers. [Turn folding](flower-turn-process-disclosure.md) owns automatic content anchors; manual toggles retain trigger. Both catalogs cover narrow/touch/focus/reduced-motion/forced colors.

concepts.title: Flower command and composer flow
concepts.summary: Each input intent has one request ID reused for retries; accepted receipts echo exact request/Thread IDs. New-thread HTTP nests it under create, existing-thread HTTP uses top-level client_request_id with URL-owned ThreadID. sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
Core commands reject missing, duplicate, invalid or conflicting IDs; only the legacy RPC adapter may fill a missing one. [Goals](../ai/flower-goals.md) share the outbox. Empty-thread creation retains text/reference/attachment authority; first Send binds staged resources to the authorized canonical thread. Unknown effect outcomes are terminal with safe explanation and no replay action.

## Immediate send feedback
The immutable transport outbox owns submitted text, references and attachment
metadata before IndexedDB or HTTP completes. Ordinary sends render a pending
user row immediately and consume only the captured draft; newer edits stay in
the composer. Request-key message and section identities survive canonical
admission, including receipt/live ordering and prepended history. Images reserve
the same thumbnail geometry and use the authorized staged preview until admitted.
Failed and unknown outcomes retain the frozen request for explicit recovery;
server 5xx responses never prove rejection or authorize a fresh request identity.

Product admission uses published SendAck and narrow canonical summaries. HTTP
and RPC return admission identity without a post-commit history read; authorized
window observation supplies presentation separately. Agent preparation binds the
already persisted execution authority to the admitted turn. No duplicate
post-admission authority write or second conversation lifecycle is introduced.
Full model history remains an engine execution requirement, not a prerequisite
for painting the submitted message.

## Restored data and preserved inputs
New submissions capture storage generation immediately, even behind paused dispatch. Rejected input stays copyable/restorable; running it requires explicit new submission, never resumed old approvals/effects.

## Context preview presentation
One Env App `FlowerContextPreviewWindow` uses existing preview/text components for launcher and draft/canonical snapshots. Launcher owns attachment IO, sequencing and URL cleanup; Flower owns validity. Related-surface markers preserve input ownership; Escape dismisses preview before companion.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Facts and eligibility
Validated turn facts carry exact TurnID/RunID, optional control kind, start/end/outcome, work/wait/elapsed time, ordered intermediate/final IDs and complete-final boundary. Summaries cannot author these facts or trigger folds; unknown prose stays visible. Typed structure determines eligibility, never prompt/time heuristics.

A thinking-only process retains its disclosure/timing without a second duration summary/divider. Other summaries show at most two nonzero units and subsecond copy. Interleaved answers default open with a whole-turn toggle; settled question/answer receipts fold with process rows and retain nested choices. Receipt decoration lives inside the viewport, leaving no folded gap/rail. Counts require complete boundaries, membership and event coverage; otherwise show canonical work duration only. [Sequences](flower-tool-sequences.md) fold settled work independently on either side.

## Disclosure ownership
Running/preparing/retrying/finalizing/waiting turns reserve inaccessible header space. Exact outcome/end enables the toggle and one automatic fold of confirmed intermediate/process rows, including latest failed/canceled/interrupted turns. Final/trailing partial output stays visible.

Focus, selection, gestures, open details/thinking and away-from-tail reading protect inspected work; later observations cannot undo protection. Capture an unaffected visible anchor only when automatic folding begins. Explicit choices survive paging/reconnect/regrouping; newly classified inspected rows remain until the next explicit toggle without reopening siblings. Only disclosure/navigation opens a closed group. Retained folded bodies are inert and preserve offsets/choices. Main/embedded/child views share rendering with independent scroll owners.

## Placement and motion
The header precedes the first loaded response after the request, independent of fold membership. Canonical intermediate membership spans same-turn executions; engine owns supersession. In-turn Goals retain ownership; final boundaries stay run-scoped. Retained prefixes preserve confirmed intermediate facts; incoming windows replace overlapping classification. Partial windows never fetch earlier history just for presentation. Prepending the actual beginning moves header while preserving choice/focus; disclosure state is independent of anchor visibility.

Reserve header geometry before eligibility so the toggle adds no space or width change. Following folds align the real bottom before paint; no stale absolute offset, synthetic trailing space or competing growth animation. Long-to-short content settles at zero with final visible. Existing finals stay mounted during 260 ms fold; reduced motion settles immediately. Paused reading/manual actions retain anchors and necessary temporary insertion room, excluded from distance-to-latest. Input immediately cancels following; motion settlement cannot reclaim it.

If prose waits for a sequence when the turn ends, the outer row owns motion and releases prose afterward. Nested geometry stays intact; interrupted inner folds transfer painted opacity/transform. Manual reversal retains choice and motion preference. Canonical Path, not timestamps, orders dialogue/receipts; preserve final segments and secret redaction.

## Outcome presentation
Terminal labels use 13px/20px text and decorative 16px Floe warning, circled-stop or circled-alert icons for failure, cancellation or interruption. Quiet label color, first-row wrap alignment and localized status retain accessibility. Existing current-run diagnostics/recovery do not acquire duplicate outcome labels.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
[Directory selection](filesystem-picker-navigation.md) owns validation; this contract owns entry points and destinations.

## Header and new-conversation entry points
The full-page header has a borderless folder/name browse button; new-conversation welcome selects the draft directory without persistent full-path secondary text. Only picker confirmation remembers a validated real directory. Browsing, cancellation, suggestions and destination navigation never write it; created-thread directories remain immutable.

## Directory and menu ownership
Right-click captures its row's thread/directory without loading, selecting or acknowledging it. Updates cannot retarget actions; handled child events cannot open outer menus. Copy/cancel restores valid triggers without scrolling.

Conversation transcript and thread-list menus expose browsing, opening a terminal, and copying the working directory. They never expose directory Favorite or Unfavorite actions; thread pinning remains a separate conversation action. Directory favorites belong to filesystem surfaces and the directory picker.

Menu actions use concise localized verbs without repeating the conversation or working-directory context: "Reference", "Copy ID", "Open folder", "Open terminal", "Copy path", "Copy", "Pin"/"Unpin", "Stop", and "Delete". The directory section retains its target path; permission explanations and deletion confirmations stay explicit. Env App and Desktop share the same labels in every shipped locale.

Directory actions retain real icons and aligned labels. Their current labels fit one line in every shipped locale; longer future labels can wrap within the menu instead of introducing horizontal scrolling. Browser visual acceptance uses the published icons and floating layer.

## Destination behavior
Activity Files reuses its singleton window/geometry; Terminal creates a new session. Workbench creates the matching widget. Request IDs, lazy loading, terminal admission and layout persistence retain ownership. Created-thread browsing includes ThreadID; menu/terminal actions require it.

## Availability and recovery
Browsing and Terminal availability are separate. Disabled reasons/errors are explicit; rejected terminal paths cannot silently fall back to Home. Existing transport, process, authorization and persistence owners remain; Flower adds no queue, lifecycle mirror or retry owner.

concepts.summary: Each Git projection belongs to one protocol client, repository and revision generation. Changes, Branches and Files have separate owners sharing monotonic invalidation. sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Capability and generation
Use workspace-v1 only after the exact client confirms revision, path-status, directory-scope and stash-section capabilities. Client replacement discards old capability/generation state and late responses. Files never falls back to unbounded legacy workspace reads. Moving from Files into Workspace opens a fresh generation before applying section/scope.

## Loading and recovery
Git shell/navigation stay mounted; each panel owns initial loading/errors without a second curtain. Diff requests and nested file references must satisfy the JSON-only transport contract.

## Invalidation
One protocol-level `GitWorkspaceInvalidationBus` advances monotonically. Every dispatched effect invalidates in `finally` for success, application failure or unknown transport result; preview/validation does not.

## Files decoration
Filesystem navigation never waits for Git. Detection uses the committed path and repository identity; prior directories cannot leak repo facts. Replacement generations are bounded and preserve committed decoration. Section identity disambiguates staged/unstaged/untracked/conflicted and stash rows.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
Workspace revisions provide read consistency, not mutation authorization. UI cancellation is an ownership optimization, not proof that a dispatched effect did not run; invalidation remains mandatory for unknown outcomes.

Non-Git Flowersec outbound allocation is outside this feature's transport budget and must not be presented as fixed by UI batching.

sections.body:
## Type roles and boundaries
Env App/Desktop bundle Inter Variable with shared script fallbacks. Guidance, errors, labels/dialogs use published roles, not ad-hoc fixed sizes or generic utilities. Root size, zoom and magnification remain user-controlled. [Message appearance](flower-message-appearance.md) owns the separate transcript reading scale.

Inline desktop actions use 28px targets; ordinary primary actions/fields use 32px. [Settings fields](runtime-settings.md#settings-controls-and-identity) follow the same published 32px control height and `--floe-radius-field` corners rather than a product-local scale. Buttons take their height, padding, radius and type size from the published `size` primitive: `icon` for square icon actions, `md` for ordinary text actions, `lg` where a 36px target was already intended. Do not re-impose heights on top of `size`, because the merge helper lets a passed class silently defeat the primitive and neighbours diverge. Ordinary rows use 30px, with the terminal navigator retaining its documented 32px rows. Coarse pointers use 44px rows/targets, 14px body and at least 16px fields; focus changes only the existing border color.

Published group spacing comes from role tokens. Measure real published components after fonts load, recording source/package identity, font, root, DPR and zoom. Mixed-script Markdown at 434px/758px must fit within 90% of the frozen reference height. Compare matching content/dimensions; another product's screenshots do not establish CSS measurements.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## One display rule
Without a successful result, retain initial presentation until authoritative data or an actionable error arrives. Mutation, attachment, maintenance and plugin execution progress remain separate from inventory loading.

## Stable geometry and retained state

Pending reads must not insert temporary rows above successful content. Use the existing action/header indicator, an accessible status outside normal flow, or a local overlay that does not alter geometry. Preserve successful same-resource lists/forms during refresh, including a successfully empty result. Equal returned items retain DOM identity, keyboard focus, expansion and scroll. Pagination keeps progress at the list end.

Initial reads use structural placeholders inside the final content region. Data-dependent editors, file previews and settings dialogs keep a responsive bounded body viewport; headers, close controls and footers stay reachable while the body scrolls. Use published Floe components and theme tokens. Do not add arbitrary delays or height animations to disguise changes.

Retention is scoped to authoritative runtime/resource/source identity. Navigation, source replacement and access loss invalidate the relevant retained state and fence late responses. Retained forms cannot submit before readiness/permission checks succeed. Keep unsaved drafts across same-resource rereads without applying stale responses to a different target. Unknown runtime status is pending, never evidence that installation is missing.

Canvas opening has a separate pending state from library initialization; keep the selected library card mounted until the canvas arrives. A file-preview request owns its path: on failure show that path with retry in the same viewport, never the previous file as the requested result. Real mutation progress, permission failures and actionable errors remain explicit.

## Page ownership
- Host Applications, Web Services, Containers and Codespaces: shared frames/list skeletons; [resource cache](env-resource-cache.md) owns snapshots, refresh and fencing.
- Files: real workspace chrome with blank regions until its first valid directory; the directory owner rejects stale responses.
- Terminal/Monitoring: shared status until catalog/first live sample or error; later attachment/polling preserves content. Metrics are not inventory snapshots.
- Settings, Flower, Tessiven, Plugin Center and dynamic plugin pages: shared module status; existing resources/runtime/lifecycle owners govern operational readiness and errors.

## Activity and Workbench
`ENV_PAGE_PRESENTATIONS` in `EnvPageLoading` exhaustively covers `BuiltinActivityPage`. New built-ins must declare loading and reload policy. [Filesystem navigation](filesystem-picker-navigation.md) retains its security boundary.

## Restore saved data

Installed plugin details expose Restore saved data in the existing action menu. Discovery is read-only, including for enabled plugins. The user selects a retained record by date and instance suffix; Disable and continue is explicit when needed, and the Host then produces the exact review. A short confirmation states that current data is also retained. No permanent card, technical hash wall or automatic re-enable is added.

The dialog binds requests to the current session owner, target instance and read/write/admin permissions. Ordinary inventory refreshes preserve the review. Closing aborts reads; reopening the same target retains an uncertain plan and only checks status. Uncertain disabling likewise refreshes authoritative inventory without repeating the write. sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Update review and confirmation
Plugin Center's Updates card and inspector expose one primary `Review update` action.

Opening it creates an exact update intent without a mutation or navigation change. Official updates immediately present the validated market preview associated with that release; they do not refresh the whole market or download an external package to prepare review. Missing previews load only the selected plugin detail for the same generation and release. External sources still use the released package-inspection API.

Official confirmation carries the reviewed full release reference, including metadata and package digests, plus the installed management revision. A changed generation, release reference or revision invalidates consent; the client never substitutes a same-version replacement. Post-submit reconciliation refreshes installed inventory only. Canceled or superseded reads cannot replace the current dialog.

Install and update dialogs size to content within viewport bounds. Identity and versions remain visible through preparation, submission and completion; brief states do not reserve a full-height shell. Long review content scrolls independently of the footer. Access requirements appear once, with concrete destinations and process/background authority visible; technical limits expand on demand.

Closing completion preserves the Updates tab, clears obsolete exact selection, and shows an `All plugins are up to date` success state when no updates remain.

## External package review
Administrators may start installation or update from a compatible public HTTPS package URL, public GitHub repository Release with optional tag, or local `.redevplugin` file. The product submits the source and intent to the released inspection API; it never downloads remote bytes in the browser, parses the package, chooses trust state, or invents provenance.

A refresh failure after a terminal install exposes only an inventory refresh recovery and never a second install action.

## Concise decision surface

The external review leads with Host-verified, locale-resolved author presentation, publisher and version. Package identifiers are technical evidence, not substitute product names when presentation exists. Verified identity is a quiet inline state; only unverified, blocked or revoked assessments receive a warning. The visual four-step timeline and generic introductory description are omitted; progress remains available to assistive technology.

Before consent, concrete destinations, requested host permissions, credentials, processes, background activity and host-facing methods remain visible. Ordinary worker methods and plugin-owned storage operations do not become broad "delete content" permission counters. Explicitly dangerous and unknown effects remain visible regardless of route. Full declarations, diffs, source evidence, hashes and inspection binding remain under a keyboard-operable package-details disclosure.

Network destinations share one access heading, with update changes marked beside the affected destination. Storage, process and background changes remain visible on their access rows. Removed declarations remain available in the full report.

One short checkbox confirms the exact inspected package. Signature validity never substitutes for consent. The review cannot claim that installation or grants already occurred; completion cannot infer permission grants from enabled state. Unknown outcomes preserve the inspection identity and reconciliation behavior. Long names and translations wrap, mobile controls retain touch targets, and footer actions remain visible.

External package installation does not grant permissions. Its detail copy states that access is managed after installation; the separate official-install approval flow retains its existing reviewed-permission contract.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Discovery and exact inventory
Activity Bar Plugins opens a Shell-root Launcher without changing the normal surface. Search intersects category with NFKC/locale-case-folded display names, canonical keywords and explicit locale aliases. Tablet/desktop details overlay the grid without reflow and restore originating-row focus.

## Session recovery
An authenticated session-ready transition invokes idempotent Host `recoverEnabled` without a stability timer. All placements consume Host `action_state`; trust, grants, policy or recovery flags cannot derive `can_open`.

## Installation and package review
[Installation progress](plugin-installation-progress.md) owns durable Execution observation and approved setup; [package review](plugin-package-review.md) owns external packages. Failures preserve placement rather than delete components.

## Permissions and policy
Plugin Center joins inventory, grants, Host requirements and policy. Method effects cannot rename granted capabilities. Failure reloads authority and requires a new confirmation.

## Activity windows and pinned pages
Each window creates one fresh `PluginSurfaceSlot` through `openSurfaceInSlot`. Opening/bridge failures replace the iframe with local recovery; timeouts explain delay and offer Retry. Restart restores shortcuts but starts on a built-in page, never automatically opens third-party content.

Reopening an existing Activity page with equivalent inventory metadata preserves its container, iframe and application state. Visibility changes use the existing slot lifecycle. A changed instance, surface, management revision or runtime generation still retires the old lease; revoked authority never survives for visual continuity. Cold opening immediately shows one host-themed accessible waiting surface, without rotating internal bootstrap-stage labels. Ready content replaces it; failures keep actionable recovery and diagnostic details.

Each pinned page runtime owns a stable registered component function. Inventory or pin updates may refresh names, icons and ordering without replacing other live page components. Removing or revoking one plugin must not recreate a sibling's iframe or discard its editing state.

The released Floe retained-view container owns sibling collection isolation and stable DOM order. Moving a retained iframe can reload its document even when the element identity survives, so acceptance checks the inner document and draft as well as the container. Redeven consumes the published implementation rather than copying a second keep-alive stack.

## Workbench widgets and placement
[Layout continuity](plugin-layout-continuity.md) owns saved bindings, atomic placement, exact removal and recovery. Status overlays cannot forward input, guess focus or create a second bridge. Unpin removes only the shortcut.

## Confirmation and teardown
One abort-aware FIFO dialog decides requests independently with initial Cancel focus. Hidden, retired or revoked surfaces cannot approve queued work. Retired surfaces cannot download; Shell neither uploads nor retains exported bytes.

It does not verify packages or releases, mint tokens, serve assets, grant permissions implicitly, or call business adapters directly.

## Persistence and permissions

Redeven owns versioned apps/terminal/groups.sqlite and views.sqlite, opened before readiness. Future/wrong-kind/drifted stores remain unchanged. Group reorder atomically persists the full non-Default order; Default stays at zero.

Views use schema kind terminal_view_catalog, version 3. RPC 2024–2027 list/put/delete/notify and 2028 atomic batch update use process-launch permission and the access gate. Records store ID, name, published SplitWorkspace geometry with product occupancy metadata, revision and timestamps. Pane-only empty:true marks a vacant slot and does not claim a session. Bounds: 64 views, 32 panes, depth 16, 64KiB layout, 128-byte IDs, 64-character names. Validate shape, unique nodes, axis and ratio. Atomic writes check every touched view and database catalog revision, rejecting duplicate session ownership. A transfer updates both source and destination in one transaction and emits one full snapshot. Stale writes reject the entire transfer. Deleting views preserves sessions. The contiguous v1→v2 migration keeps each session in the highest-revision view (then newest creation time, then lexical ID), prunes duplicate leaves from older trees and deletes empty aliases without modifying sessions or PTYs. The contiguous v2→v3 migration verifies existing records unchanged and enables vacant slots. Session closure vacates its owned slot atomically with a fresh identity, retaining geometry and emitting a catalog snapshot before the closure notification. Invalid stores fail unchanged.

## Projection and interaction

One Terminal Session Catalog Provider owns membership/display order. Lifecycle fences prevent stale replies overwriting moves/deletes; unknown groups refresh without reassignment. Group deletion closes/hides members first; failures identify sessions without fabricated success or silent retry.

Search matches group names/paths and session presentation, revealing folded matches temporarily. Views filter by name. Sidebar defaults to 258px, persists per environment/panel within 220–480px and reserves content space. Floe ResizeHandle owns pointer resizing; arrows/Home/End support keyboards. Overlays retain independent width.

Search/refresh replaces Quick switch. Desktop rows are 32px; mobile targets are larger. Groups show Floe yellow folder icons, disclosure, creation and actions. Rounded session tiles use fill selection without rails. View/group rows have no quantity badges. Paths stay in tooltips; less frequent actions use accessible menus. Session close appears directly on row hover/focus and on touch.

Rows/icons drag independently of buttons. Session previews follow the pointer across scaled Workbench; group previews remain in the sidebar. Split drops change placement only; group targets own membership/order. Metadata must not remount runtimes.

Automatic layout and library thumbnails use the same published Floe layout engine, direction, layers, and visibility projection. Saved positions guide ordering within a layer and never override its rank. Positioned objects without relationships still contribute their actual world bounds, so fitting a newly mapped or isolated node keeps it inside the viewport.

## Connection scopes
Default browsing shows one directed overview connector per root endpoint pair. Group-internal relationships remain in the canonical pool overview and never create a group self-loop.

The interactive overview and library thumbnails always paint the root overview, even while the main canvas shows a focused host's detailed paths.

## Controls and rendering
- Canvas controls expand or collapse all logical groups in one compact reflow. They preserve the selected visible object, or its enclosing group when hidden,   and never create a document version. Large-graph   qualification measures actual host counts, including groups of ten   so a thousand-host fixture never silently measures only aggregate cards.

sections.title: Contract

## Reading surface
The window uses the theme's main reading surface continuously across its titlebar, transcript and composer surroundings. A subtle border and shadow frame compact readable message spacing; canvas nodes must not bleed through reply text.

End padding keeps the final choice fully readable when scrolled to the bottom; the action controls remain outside the fade.

## Actions and continuity
Less frequent actions live in the More menu: new conversation, settings, subagents, available Computer actions and opening the full conversation.

Messages, tool disclosures, questions, approvals and errors remain canonical.

Existing canvases open the combined window directly.

concepts.title: UI presentation transactions
concepts.summary: Heavy navigation acknowledges selection synchronously, commits target visibility after that intent can paint, then performs focus, resize, scroll or measurement after content paint. Published Floe separates visual from committed values; Redeven applies this ordering across Activity, Workbench, terminal, Flower, Files/Git and heavy panels without duplicating business state.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Mechanism
Initialization, persisted restoration, permission correction, automatic open and recovery use synchronous canonical commitment such as `commitNow()`. Genuinely blocking operations keep their dedicated presentation.

## Activity and retained content
Activity uses Shell UI-first mode and after-paint activation. Files preserves hidden virtual-grid measurements, usable width/range/scroll. Flower keeps the previous transcript during cold selection and replaces it only when the latest destination is ready.

## Measurement
Debug Console groups presentation events by surface/source. User interactions must avoid renderer tasks/frame gaps of 50 ms or more. Instrumentation flags intent at 32 ms and content at 100 ms; focused performance/browser gates enforce distributions and long-task limits.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
